page_title: GIR 2-1 VAL | Girona v Valencia 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) picked up a yellow card from referee.
90+4' The goal by Girona is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
90+3' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Girona players aren’t happy.
90+2' Savio (Girona) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+1' Goal! Portu provides Savio (Girona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the top right corner. 3:1.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Ruben Baraja decides to make a substitution. Yarek Gasiorowski will be replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
88' 2 - 1 Goal! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 2:1.
86' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
86' Yan Couto (Girona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball has crossed the sideline. Valencia are taking a throw-in.
84' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Dimitri Foulquier is replaced by Selim Amallah (Valencia).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) will replace Hugo Duro.
84' It is time for a substitution. Sergi Canos (Valencia) is on for Diego Lopez.
82' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Yan Couto plays it into the box, and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:1.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ivan Martin departs the field of play to be replaced by Portu (Girona).
81' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yan Couto (Girona) replacing Pablo Torre.

81' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a comfortable save.

79' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
78' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Iglesias Villanueva had an easy-decision to make.
77' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

76' A cross into the box picks out Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
75' The referee allows time for a substitution. David Lopez will be replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).

75' A neat pass is well received by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
75' Pablo Torre (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' The ball possession at the moment is 75:25.
73' Aleix Garcia (Girona) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
73' Pepelu (Valencia) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Girona are awarded a free kick.
72' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
71' Handball! A player from Valencia handled the ball. A free kick is awarded to Girona.
71' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Pablo Torre (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
69' Savio (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to gather the ball.
69' Savio (Girona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
68' Hugo Duro (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
67' A substitution has been made. Fran Perez is replaced by Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia).
65' Girona string together a series of short passes.
62' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
61' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) brings an opponent down and Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game. Girona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
56' 0 - 1 Goal! Hugo Duro (Valencia) skips past challenges and from close range brilliantly chips the ball over Paulo Gazzaniga. 0:1. Wonderful individual effort.
56' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Aleix Garcia (Girona) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him. Now Girona have a corner.
55' Some neat passing and movement from Girona as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

51' Aleix Garcia (Girona) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the roof of the net, but Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
50' Good movement by Savio (Girona), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
48' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
48' Diego Lopez (Valencia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball.
47' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
44' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
44' Diego Lopez (Valencia) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

43' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' Although Yan Couto (Girona) is just on the bench, Javier Iglesias Villanueva has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
40' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Artem Dovbyk (Girona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
39' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Artem Dovbyk (Girona), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
36' Javier Iglesias Villanueva shows a yellow card to Daley Blind (Girona) for his blatant foul.
36' Savio (Girona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Viktor Tsygankov, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
35' Ivan Martin (Girona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
34' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pablo Torre (Girona). The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
33' A spell of possession for Girona in an attempt to control the game.
30' Diego Lopez (Valencia) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Paulo Gazzaniga makes a save.
29' Diego Lopez (Valencia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
27' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
24' The Girona players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

22' What a miss! Fran Perez (Valencia) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
20' Aleix Garcia (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
19' Valencia take a short corner kick.
19' Fran Perez (Valencia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Valencia.
17' Hugo Duro (Valencia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

15' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
13' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is substituted due to injury. Michel gives a chance to Pablo Torre.
12' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
11' Yangel Herrera (Girona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
10' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
9' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
6' Savio (Girona) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.

5' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' A cross into the box from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared.
2' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
1' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Valencia will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Javier Iglesias Villanueva.
